# ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops Daily Update (Jun 11, 2026)

## OVERVIEW 
Today's development focused on enhancing simulation tools, improving CI performance by deprecating stale test fixtures, and migrating `mise` aliases. Several long-standing issues related to simulation, testing, and documentation were also closed.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

### Enhanced Tenderly Simulation Support
Support for Tenderly's new `?draft=` simulation link format was added, ensuring compatibility with recent breaking changes in how the Simulator hydrates pre-filled forms from URLs. This update affects documentation, runbooks, and core libraries. ([#1458](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/pull/1458))

### CI Performance Improvements
Stale, duplicate, and deprecated example task fixtures were removed from `template_regression_tests` to significantly reduce CI runtime and improve overall performance. ([#1461](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/pull/1461))

### Infrastructure Tooling Updates
The `mise` configuration was updated by replacing deprecated `[alias]` with `[tool_alias]` and aligning Foundry alias styles with the Optimism monorepo. The pinned `mise` installer was also bumped to `v2026.5.18`. ([#1456](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/pull/1456))

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
- A new pull request, [#1460](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/pull/1460), was opened to shard template regression simulations, likely aiming to further improve CI efficiency.

## CLOSED ISSUES

### Simulation and Signing Workflow Improvements
Several issues related to simulation and signing workflows were closed. This includes resolving problems with `just sign-stack` not showing valid owner safes ([#1295](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/1295)), and addressing the need for `just simulate` to check Ledger signer connectivity before running tasks ([#417](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/417)). Additionally, the ability to run multiple proposals with a single command was implemented, closing a long-standing request ([#432](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/432)).

### Documentation and Testing Enhancements
Documentation for simulation links was updated to reflect changes in how Base prints them, covering large-calldata Raw Input fallbacks for Tenderly simulations ([#789](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/789)). A tracking issue for CI checks on domain hash and message in `Validation.md` was also closed, as CI stack simulations now validate these against generated `dataToSign` ([#717](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/717)).

### Codebase Maintenance and Deprecation
Issues related to outdated monorepo dependencies causing compiler errors ([#424](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/424)) and the `DisputeGameUpgrade` flow ([#444](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/444)) were closed as stale or resolved by newer implementations. A bug in `AccountAccessParser` regarding tightly packed variables was also fixed ([#909](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/909)), and a Wiz scan overview for the 'main' branch reported no findings ([#1411](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/1411)).

## NEW ISSUES

### Improving Simulation Output User Experience
A new issue, [#1459](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/1459), was opened to improve the user experience of simulation output for signers and upgrade-task authors. The current console output of `just simulate` / `just simulate-stack` is deemed difficult to act on safely, highlighting a need for clearer, actionable artifacts for signers.

## ACTIVE ISSUES

### Cannon Kona Migration and Deprecation
Discussions around the `cannon-op-e2e-tests` CI job switching to `kona-proof` instead of `op-program` ([#19789](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/19789)) concluded with the task being marked as done. Similarly, the `op-devstack` issue to rebuild program prestate ([#17867](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/17867)) was closed as `op-program` is no longer supported, and `RUST_JIT_BUILD` now handles Kona prestate rebuilding. The issue regarding `op-program`'s `vm-compat` failing for `go1.25` binaries ([#18334](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/18334)) was also closed due to `op-program` no longer being supported.

### Interop Filter RPC Node Validation
The issue concerning Interop Filter RPC Node Validation ([#21190](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/21190)) was closed, with a linked pull request indicating that the necessary pruning configuration for nodes to support appropriate history for the interop filter has been addressed.

### CANNON_KONA Feature Flag Removal
The issue to remove the `CANNON_KONA` feature flag after the U19 contracts audit ([#20249](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/20249)) is active, with a comment from Inphi asking for confirmation from @pauldowman that the audit is complete and the flag can be removed.
